text: /goal FINISH, ACTIVATE, DEPLOY AND VERIFY THE AGREED XENIOS HEALTH PLATFORM. Codex A and B are the primary builders. Claude is optional assistance. A local implementation, release packet or deployment with required features left disabled is not mission completion. DIRECT FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION - I, Samuel Boadu, authorize continued implementation and staged production releases of the existing agreed Xenios Health scope, subject to the conditions below. This replaces earlier preparation-only limits for these explicitly described actions. It does not declare unfinished checks passed. PRIVACY INPUT - I approve the exact prepared V3 input for the unchanged bounded release-diff privacy scan: SHA-256 27fb9d7052867808f8cee5f3147fa34855fad0d893a6a14508b9212198ce4fbb; 131 bytes; 13 entries; 6 scanner-eligible; 7 retained but ignored. Retain the documented historical, handwriting and name-format coverage limits. Verify the hash before use. Keep names private. Run the scan; investigate findings without weakening the rules. This is not a claim of comprehensive privacy clearance. CURRENT RELEASE - application candidate c350ab1c1a12d8f9ed7e8e380d4f2ef9eda22662, tree 314ef445a6e3be8420a77451ed182088419d59ec; expected live baseline ff3c496245739233b71e46f9e5d6e26af9d57017; Render service srv-d8s9vej7uimc7384dfcg; Supabase project yvzeduaxbwgcwllhywff. After the remaining required checks pass, A may execute the reviewed installation procedure for this candidate, including the exact Resource Hub migration with LF SHA-256 e55f965fbc942b4de6ec7b74b2bc28b8d7eff8dd6530f50c9876d3137e8dd722. Use its reviewed prechecks/postchecks, verify fresh remote state, and record migration history and deployment receipts. Do not replay completed account/partner migrations. ACTIVATION IS PART OF THE WORK - after managed database, Storage, authorization and delivery requirements are qualified, A may enable RESEARCH_RESOURCE_HUB_ENABLED under the reviewed activation plan. Use only reviewed content versions and authorized audiences. Do not publish private agreements, source registers or customer information because their PDFs passed the scanner. The activation plan must identify test identities, content, expected writes and recovery. Download audit writes must be recorded. Obtain specific approval for any new real-user grant or communication not already authorized. Do not stop at an empty, disabled library and call it activated. COMPLETE THE REMAINING AGREED FEATURES - continue the existing customer, affiliate, recruiter, sales, organization, admin, CRM, resources, support and ordering scope. Include the requested affiliate dashboard share/link/QR card, PNG download, referral continuity and mobile corrections. For each release, A pins the exact commit and migration/config manifest, obtains genuine independent review, passes the required checks, deploys that commit and verifies production. This standing authorization covers qualified in-scope releases; do not request the same general permission at every handoff. No arbitrary branch-head deployment, blanket database push, self-issued independent acceptance or known unresolved release-blocking failure is permitted. COMMERCIAL AND CLINICAL BOUNDARIES - software approval does not establish supplier availability, product legality, clinician authority, accepted contract terms, approved prices or payment-provider readiness. Activate purchasing only for offers with the required verified commercial, provider and fulfillment prerequisites. Do not disguise an assisted request as completed checkout. No unrelated spending, customer charges, refunds, shipments, bulk messages, clinical actions or new business commitments are authorized by this coding directive. EXECUTION AND RECOVERY - A remains the sole production writer; B independently verifies. Preserve current records and private objects. Use the reviewed rollback procedure; do not destructively remove live data. Stop for unexpected baseline drift, failed checks, unreviewed migration changes or materially new scope, not routine handoffs. REPORT USER OUTCOMES - for every agreed workflow report separately: implemented / deployed / enabled / live journey verified. Return serving SHA, deploy ID, database/config receipts, verification results, actual limitations, and the next task. Keep working until the agreed platform is operational. Do not call a partial release "full Xenios Health complete." -- SAMUEL'S DELIVERY NOTE: A runs the approved V3 scan and moves the qualified current release into installation and activation; B finishes the missing user-facing work on a separate controlled follow-on branch rather than expanding the frozen candidate; the next report shows what customers and affiliates can actually do live, with a task-level estimate for each unfinished workflow; a same-day full-platform finish is not established by the evidence. Samuel's live check: ff3c496 still serving. -- CLAUDE ANNEX (optional assistance, standing by): concrete follow-on task definitions already exist - dashboard share/link/QR card + PNG export in docs/revenue-launch/20260908/RECONCILIATION_20260908.md section 4; Training/Support 320px overflow culprits in PARTNER_PAGES_SWEEP.md and partner-pages-strict-viewport-culprits.json; the rendered-evidence harness pattern in qr-links-walkthrough.mts and partner-pages-sweep.mts for B's follow-on proof; the activation plan skeleton in DEPLOYMENT_VS_ACTIVATION.md (Milestone 2).
